methodology: WebGL landmark-only scene; real StructureModelLibrary, optional StructureLodStreamer, and shared materials. Two simultaneous initial acquisitions; detail concurrency follows the selected preset. Cold loopback HTTP, no network throttling. Synthetic grid. No terrain, traffic, sky reflections or tile scheduler. Two material workers bake used surfaces. Streaming samples follow 300 settling frames; the pan rotates 20 degrees in place. Timings include only this workload.
limitations: Workstation measurements with phone/laptop budgets; physical target device acceptance is pending.
Unthrottled loopback HTTP with warm OS caches; first-load bytes exclude sidecars and pack metadata.
Other repository verification ran concurrently; timing values are diagnostic single samples.
Geometry byte estimates exclude parser temporaries, transport caches, JS objects and driver overhead.
Shared texture bytes include estimated mipmaps; no terrain, traffic, reflections or shadows.
Some detailed tiers exceed advisory triangle targets and cannot be admitted under small-device budgets.
Automated validity is not comprehensive visual approval of all four levels of every model.
